Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1628465. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary filtering by target ChEMBL ID. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES. Filter rows where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation equals '=', and pChEMBL value is not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to the first 1000 rows.
